units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: For an overview of the changes across all documents, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: If there is a __TRILIUM_PH_0__hoisted note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or a __TRILIUM_PH_2__workspace__TRILIUM_PH_3__, the list of recent changes will be limited to the descendents of the hoisted note, or the workspace.
units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: Right-clicking or pressing and holding the button lists up to 15 of the most recently changed notes that are not open in a tab. Selecting a note opens it in a new tab.
units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: To limit the list of recent changes to a note and its descendants, look for the corresponding option in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note tree contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → Advanced.
units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: Right-clicking or pressing and holding the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button of the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Tabs__TRILIUM_PH_2__ bar lists the most recently changed notes that are not open in a tab. __TRILIUM_PH_3__All recent changes__TRILIUM_PH_4__, at the bottom of that menu, opens this dialog.
units.context: Recent Changes > Accessing the recent changes

units.source: Notes which were changed will appear in reverse chronological order (latest update first).
The title of the note is displayed, as well as the note path. Clicking on the note title will dismiss the dialog and navigate to that particular note.
Deleted notes will also be listed here, at their time of deletion. Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Undelete__TRILIUM_PH_1__ link next to them in order to recover them.
